notes.title: Update Chapter 5 - While True
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you guys for liking Cyber Manhunt. We really appreciate your feedback and suggestion which help us a lot to make this game better. My team will keep our best work on this game.
Right now Chapter 5 has finished, please update the game and try it! There are almost 2 years since we started this game. We know it is really hard for an indie game studio, but during this period, we got a lot of help and support from you guys which is really important for us to keep working on this game. The future plan of DLC and new content will be coming soon!
Please feel free to email us if you have any questions or feedback. We will give you response ASAP:
cmh@mysgame.top.

Update list:
[olist]
[*] New Content: Chapter 5
[*] New OST
[*] Fix some UI bugs
[*] Fix some Text bugs
[*] Fix PR-mini game bug
[*] Fix CIO’s dialog bug
[*] Fix Chapter Select Screen bug
[*] Fix Tutorial bug
[*] Fix UI problem on Mac
[*] Add FREE Original SoundTracks
[/olist]

notes.title: Early Access Update to v1.1.25

[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue which someone can’t get the achievement of Flowers on The Table.
[*] Optimizing the Forgot Password logic of Toothbook.
[*] Optimizing the Full Screen logic in most kinds of screen resolution. 
[*] Fixed some English translation errors.
[*] Fixed display errors in some special conditions.
[*] Optimizing the tips – You can’t close the game when it is saving data automatically.
[*] Fixed the issue which restart the game from tutorial when reading damaged save file.

[*] New feature: Announcement
[*] New feature: Tell you how many clues you get before submit the information.
[*] Fixed the DOB of Lisa’s ex-husband Antony in chapter 1.
[*] Fixed the display error of Meson Toney’s name in Toothbook in chapter 2.
[*] Fixed the some display errors in chapter 3.
[*] Fixed the issue which the clues can’t be counted when you invade Jim’s phone.
[*] Fixed the issue which the sound effective is still on when Van invades Servers even you close it.
[*] Fixed the issue which the clues can’t be counted when you make anonymous call.
[/olist]
